title: ProQR Announces Third Quarter 2026 Operating and Financial Results
summary: ProQR is a clinical stage biotech company based in the Netherlands that discovers and develops unique RNA-based therapies for severe genetic disorders.
body_markdown:
- Fully enrolled Cohorts 1 and 2 of AX-0811 Phase 1 trial; initial target engagement data expected in early January 2027
- Full AX-0810 Phase 1 dataset, including Cohort 3 and follow-up data, and new AX-0811 preclinical proof-of-concept data to be presented in December 2026
- Multiple clinical milestones expected in H1 of 2027, including initiation of pediatric biliary atresia IIT, initial AX-0422 patient data in MPS I Hurler syndrome, and advancement of AX-2911 into the clinic for MASH IIT
- Ended Q3 2026 with € 103 million cash and cash equivalents, supporting runway into mid-2028


LEIDEN, Netherlands & CAMBRIDGE, Mass., Nov. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- ProQR Therapeutics N.V. (Nasdaq: PRQR) (ProQR), a clinical-stage company dedicated to changing lives through transformative RNA therapies based on its proprietary Axiomer™ RNA editing technology platform, today reported its financial and operating results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, and provided a business update.


“Having established the first clinical validation of our Axiomer RNA editing platform, we are now expanding our pipeline on that foundation through several other programs that are entering clinical development,” said Daniel A. de Boer, Founder and Chief Executive Officer of ProQR. “The Phase 1 study of AX-0811 has now fully enrolled its first two cohorts. AX-0811 is our next-generation editing oligonucleotide targeting NTCP for cholestatic diseases, including biliary atresia. We also strengthened our AI capabilities through the appointment of Chris Hart as Chief Data and AI Officer and Thomas Wolf to our Board as a strategic AI advisor.”


De Boer continued, “We expect to report initial AX-0811 data in early January 2027 and look forward to presenting the full AX-0810 Phase 1 dataset, including Cohort 3, in December 2026. We expect these data to be followed by a series of additional clinical milestones across our pipeline in the first half of 2027, including initiation of our biliary atresia clinical program, initial patient data from AX-0422 in MPS I Hurler syndrome, and advancement of AX-2911 for MASH into the clinic. Across these programs, our focus remains on developing RNA editing therapies that can make a meaningful difference for patients and their families.”


**Recent Progress and Anticipated Upcoming Events**


**Clinical Development Progress with NTCP Programs**


Following the positive AX-0810 Phase 1 target engagement data reported in June 2026, ProQR expects to present the full dataset, including Cohort 3 and 12-week follow up, at the Nature Conferences RNA at the Bench and Bedside V meeting in December 2026.


In September 2026, ProQR announced the dosing of the first participant in the Phase 1 clinical trial of AX-0811, the Company’s next-generation editing oligonucleotide targeting NTCP, which was identified through ProQR’s AI-enabled discovery engine. The first two cohorts of healthy volunteers are now fully enrolled, with initial AX-0811 Phase 1 target engagement data expected in early January 2027. The study is evaluating the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, and pharmacodynamic effects via biomarker-based target engagement. AX-0811 preclinical data demonstrate greater potency and a longer half-life compared with AX-0810, with the potential for lower dose levels and less frequent dosing in the clinic.


In September 2026, the Company hosted a[virtual educational event focused on NTCP modulation in biliary atresia through liver-targeted RNA editing](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=4eEO8nRucQ6DQR2-DY-tPLchkxFOvqmHLgQHuzCJ1CQALQC8kuNW_z_TJX_0du02656VlCiXugw0IOtYVdDHnEbkSJOAvaW8JgztB_vxf4rDkJnNe5jCpstqoOuSK7ZhFJCEQxS3AJBmTzoWXkO6mjxt2p2yhgj7yE1R5UaAPt_ETbJAo9QXj-AIjW8l8_BAEIB1alSn-nbMuC_4AoBTIGtINxXmpUv92KHpdAVRoE-UxEHQmpva-4QkzobFTbw1egMNtQIWt71LYziCHGzB5dL2_3eNxqKFXVxMhDBt7D-dKdLMRm6rCwmP3Xmv940K-kXHkRTsUyXDKCkcXTZvlyOvVq-W04GgQ-I15H8DAlCHnh_Bd9W3aU0SMEq3xJF6) . The event featured ProQR management and Professor Gideon Hirschfield of the Toronto Centre for Liver Disease and provided an overview of bile acid biology, NTCP modulation, translational rationale and clinical development strategy for RNA editing NTCP modulation in biliary atresia. The event outlined the framework for evaluating upcoming AX-0811 Phase 1 target engagement data:


- TUDCA is expected to be the most sensitive measure for comparing pharmacodynamic effects,
- Conjugated bile acid profile will be informative for assessing translation into the disease setting, and
- Total bile acids in serum provides an additional supportive measure of target engagement.


Based on preclinical data, ProQR expects AX-0811 to outperform AX-0810 across all three biomarkers in equivalent cohorts.


ProQR is also continuing preparations for an investigator-initiated trial (IIT) in pediatric biliary atresia in China, with initial clinical data expected in the first half of 2027.


**Conference Presentations**


In November 2026, ProQR participated in[TIDES Europe and The Liver Meeting 2026, the annual meeting of the American Association for the Study of Liver Diseases (AASLD), where presentations](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=YN23DcPDKiTAcKCeE2v2CoqGaVh5AsselrXOCayRVqXaGvGZSURKkWYu5HgaKqSyZqS33kuDH6_4bF_qttizrHQJfxh1RPxSrWPBx6q30gxQe2RjxBobzNe5GUXtT_CBiah85tOd8bfP3S5R0BbuFBrkdBmkLjep8AbByfx7CuJx_Ey8fGSfsyVnYeL0VVWKJYtPMO2kKSWYTrIBLrowkY5_7rDHmuQp9wJ-mXG4n1Igehu1ZEORSDD2KW3l94FYEJvopVllVye-C7Qd0_pB190PQ1UUnYL5nScl1GK_XCg40ni6YZAGaRC0yXNHyGL3) highlighted previously disclosed AX-0810 clinical findings and preclinical data for AX-0811.


**Strengthening AI and Data Capabilities**


In September 2026, ProQR appointed Chris Hart, PhD, as Chief Data and AI Officer. Dr. Hart most recently served as Vice President of Data Science and AI/ML for Genetic Medicines at Eli Lilly and Company and has more than 15 years of experience applying AI/ML to oligonucleotide therapeutics. ProQR also announced in September that Thomas Wolf, PhD, co-founder and Chief Scientific Officer of Hugging Face, has joined ProQR’s Board of Directors as a strategic AI advisor.


**Upcoming anticipated milestones**


**NTCP programs**


- AX-0810 data from the 9 mg/kg cohort and 12-week follow up from the ongoing Phase 1 study and new preclinical data for AX-0811 expected in December 2026
- AX-0811 initial target engagement data from Cohorts 1 and 2 in healthy volunteers expected in early January 2027
- IIT in pediatric biliary atresia in China, with initiation and initial data targeted for the first half of 2027
- Potentially registration-enabling Phase 2 program, subject to regulatory interactions, expected to start in mid-2027 with first interim analysis data expected by mid-2028


**Other pipeline candidates**


- AX-0422 for MPS I Hurler Syndrome (IDUA) CTA filing for a first-in-patient study anticipated in early 2027 and initial data expected in the first half of 2027
- AX-2911 (PNPLA3) FIH IIT in China expected in the first half of 2027


**Partnership**


- Continue to execute on Lilly collaboration, with potential data updates and milestone payments


**Financial Highlights**


At September 30, 2026, ProQR held cash and cash equivalents of approximately € 103.0 million, compared to € 92.4 million at December 31, 2025.


Net cash used in operating activities during the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 was € 13.6 million, compared to € 12.2 million used for the same period in 2025.


Research and development (R&D) costs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 were € 14.3 million, compared to € 11.1 million for the same period last year.


General and administrative costs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 were € 4.0 million, compared to € 3.1 million for the same period in 2025.


Net loss for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 was € 12.4 million, or € 0.09 per diluted share, compared to € 11.0 million, or € 0.10 per diluted share, for the same period in 2025.


For further financial information for the period ended September 30, 2026, please refer to our Q3 financial report filing available on our website,[www.proqr.com](http://www.proqr.com/) under Financials and Filings.


**About Axiomer** **™**


ProQR is pioneering a next-generation RNA base editing technology called Axiomer™, which could potentially yield a new class of medicines for diverse types of diseases. Axiomer™ “Editing Oligonucleotides”, or EONs, mediate single nucleotide changes to RNA in a highly specific and targeted way using molecular machinery that is present in human cells called ADAR (Adenosine Deaminase Acting on RNA). Axiomer™ EONs are designed to recruit and direct endogenously expressed ADARs to change an Adenosine (A) to an Inosine (I) in the RNA – an Inosine is translated as a Guanosine (G) – correcting an RNA with a disease-causing mutation back to a normal (wild type) RNA, modulating protein expression, or altering a protein so that it will have a new function that helps prevent or treat disease.


**About ProQR**


ProQR Therapeutics is a clinical-stage company dedicated to changing lives through the creation of transformative RNA therapies. ProQR is pioneering a next-generation RNA technology called Axiomer™, which uses a cell’s own editing machinery called ADAR to make specific single nucleotide edits in RNA to reverse a mutation or modulate protein expression and could potentially yield a new class of medicines for both rare and prevalent diseases with unmet need. Based on our unique proprietary RNA repair platform technologies we are growing our pipeline with patients and loved ones in mind.


Learn more about ProQR at[www.proqr.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=FRuG0G8-VkBvwlwp_xjpaduorj4gMIqUThzm14WN5MMOYYrtJcji8hc5k5zQiJ1gUBNP57tV0mqul7EZLUgW2Q==) .
